Gjoa v0.4.4 updates the browser base to Firefox 153.0.3 and repairs toolbar regressions introduced by the Firefox 153 transition.

## Highlights

- Updated the engine to Firefox 153.0.3, including the fixes covered by Mozilla advisory MFSA 2026-73.
- Reworked toolbar ordering so the sidebar controls join the left cluster in vertical mode and follow the address bar in horizontal mode.
- Restored the reload and sidebar buttons for profiles whose saved toolbar state was damaged by the Firefox 153 migration.
- Made the Ctrl+L palette appear faster and removed its keyboard handler cleanly when the drawer is torn down.
- Standardized the Windows release artifact as a ZIP archive.

## Downloads

- Linux x86_64: tar.xz or AppImage
- Linux ARM64: tar.xz or AppImage
- macOS ARM64: DMG
- Windows x86_64: ZIP

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tompassarelli/gjoa/compare/v0.4.3...v0.4.4
